name: echo
description: Search your own E.C.H.O memory: the emails, web pages and YouTube videos you captured. Read-only.
long_description: E.C.H.O (Efficient Contextualized History Orchestrator) is a local-first personal memory. This extension starts the E.C.H.O MCP server from your project folder, using the project's own Python virtual environment. It offers two read-only tools: search_memories and get_memory. PostgreSQL must be running; Redis is needed only for attachment text.

tools.name: search_memories
tools.description: Search your captured emails, web pages and YouTube videos. Read-only.

tools.name: get_memory
tools.description: Read more of one memory item, and on request its attachment text. Read-only.

project_dir.title: E.C.H.O project folder
project_dir.description: The folder that contains .venv, mcp_server, rse and ste (for example C:\E.C.H.O).
